definitions.explanation: A respectful way to refer to multiple people; the plural form of 方 (かた).

examples.notes: [Note: がた is a variant reading when attached to other nouns]

examples.japanese: ご{出席|しゅっせき}の{方々|かたがた}
{関係者|かんけいしゃ}の{方々|かたがた}
{本日|ほんじつ}ご{参加|さんか}いただきました{方々|かたがた}に、{心|こころ}より{御礼|おんれい}{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to all those who participated today.

notes:
{方々|かたがた} is the respectful plural of {方|かた} (person).

USAGE:
- Used in formal speech and writing
- Often in business, ceremonies, announcements
- More respectful than {人|ひと}たち or {人々|ひとびと}

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {皆様|みなさま}{方|がた} (everyone, very polite)
- 〜の{方々|かたがた} (the people who ~)
- ご{参加|さんか}の{方々|かたがた} (participants)

NOTE: {方々|ほうぼう} with different reading means 'various places'.
